title: Wembanyama within sight of 'childhood dream' after Spurs stun Thunder
summary: French basketball prodigy Victor Wembanyama is within sight of realizing a lifelong dream after the San Antonio Spurs stunned the Oklahoma City Thunder Saturday, making their way to the upcoming NBA Finals showdown with the New York Knicks. The win marked another dazzling milestone on Wembanyama's rise as the new face of the NBA.
